slice_contract.real_problem: M19 stopped on the first scheduled arm after one physical request failed before response headers, finish, usage or actionable output. The typed terminal and exact Store reopen must be classified without treating billing_unknown, the external verifier snapshot or the 14 unexecuted arms as product evidence.
acceptance: validate one exact 0600 regular non-symlink 8-record hash-chained journal with no partial tail
derive exactly one canonical Store trajectory and zero complete arm labels while preserving the accounting_incomplete abort
classify the first trajectory as measurement_incomplete because billing_unknown prevents a complete label
keep all unexecuted schedule arms and the initial failing external verifier outside product-loss labels
require one identical stable loss code across at least two distinct task IDs before returning an owner audit
expose only canonical counts, stable failure codes and task IDs; never expose prompt, reasoning, tool arguments/content, evaluation IDs or credential material
produce byte-identical canonical JSON across repeated runs without credential read or network access

slice_contract.old_path_replaced: manual raw inspection or treating a pre-header transport/accounting stop as a coding outcome
slice_contract.cutover: retain immutable raw identity and one read-only report; do not implement a production treatment from this interrupted acquisition

derivation.canonical_source: canonical_store_snapshot payload facts and canonical Runtime events
